subject: design/read-to-rule-tech-design-v1
statement: This design ships the §0 **routing section** only; it does **not** extend `read-to-rule-v1`'s federated capture-line convention to design review gates. The capture line measures review efficiency by federating per-gate minutes and per-item routing into the review-feedback ledger — machinery `read-to-rule-v1` scoped to PRD gates and tied to the still-maturing review-feedback-capture feature. Design review has two candidate gates — the unmanned `tech-design-review` and the human approval — either of which could one day carry the line, but binding that measurement now would couple this template change to another feature's timing, the I1-class inversion `read-to-rule-v1` itself rejected as its ALT-2. The graduation path is explicit and symmetric with `read-to-rule-v1`'s own: when design-review efficiency measurement is wanted, a later change extends the capture-line convention to design gates through the review-feedback feature's channel (Q2). Until then, §0 for designs is a routing aid with no measurement obligation.
